items.headline: AI Incident Database recorded 362 documented AI incidents in 2025, up 55 percent from 2024
items.summary: The AI Incident Database documented 362 AI incidents in 2025, a 55 percent increase from 233 in 2024, marking the highest annual count in the database's history. The most common failure types are hallucination, prompt injection, data leaks, and jailbreaks. US courts imposed over 145,000 dollars in AI hallucination sanctions in Q1 2026, including Oregon's record 110,000 dollar penalty. ECRI ranked AI chatbot misuse as the single greatest health technology hazard of 2026.

items.headline: EU AI Act becomes fully enforceable on August 2 2026 making EU first jurisdiction with comprehensive AI regulation
items.summary: The European Union's AI Act becomes fully enforceable on August 2, 2026, making the EU the first jurisdiction in history to impose comprehensive, binding regulations on artificial intelligence systems. The Act uses a four-tier risk classification system with penalties reaching 35 million euros or 7 percent of global turnover. Prohibited AI practices and AI literacy obligations entered into application from February 2025, while governance rules and obligations for GPAI models became applicable in August 2025.
